name: Wbcom Designs - Shortcodes & Elementor Widgets For BuddyPress

promises.claim: [members-listing] and [groups-listing] with grid="yes" show loop_layout one, two, three and four as 1, 2, 3 and 4 columns on desktop, on BuddyPress and BuddyBoss Platform, on Reign and BuddyX; grid="no" is a plain one-per-row list whatever loop_layout says
the grid collapses to 1 column at 479px and below and 3 or 4 columns drop to 2 between 480px and 598px

on Reign an omitted loop_layout follows the site's BuddyPress directory layout (bp_nouveau_appearance members_layout / groups_layout); an explicit loop_layout always wins; elsewhere, and on BuddyBoss where that setting does not exist, the default is three

per_page that is zero, negative, empty or not a number falls back to the shortcode default, any per_page is capped at 100, and an unknown type on [members-listing] or [groups-listing] falls back to that shortcode's default type
the Elementor Members List, Groups List and Activity List widgets render through the same shortcode classes, and an Elementor-only page still loads the plugin CSS and JS

[activity-listing] shows the post form only when allow_posting is true and the visitor is logged in; load more pages the stream through the public bpsp_activities_load AJAX call with nonce bpsp-nonce and a limit clamped to 1-50

with BuddyPress inactive or a component off, each shortcode shows its 'please enable' notice instead of a fatal, and the plugin deactivates itself on the next admin load when neither BuddyPress nor BuddyBoss Platform is active

when Shortcodes for BuddyPress Pro is active the free plugin deactivates itself and shows the 'cannot be activated simultaneously' notice, so Pro's templates own every listing; free behaviour is only tested with Pro off
the admin panel (WB Plugins > BP Shortcodes) is informational, needs manage_options, stores no options, and uninstall has nothing to remove
